scripts.build: if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json; elif [ -x ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json; else echo 'TypeScript compiler not found' >&2; exit 1; fi && mkdir -p dist/data && cp data/*.json dist/data/
scripts.lint: if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit; elif [ -x ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit; else echo 'TypeScript compiler not found' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node -e "require('./dist/index.js'); console.log('backend smoke ok')"
